item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
